en.s: The Battle of Tzirallum was part of the civil wars of the Tetrarchy fought on 30 April 313 between the Roman armies of emperors Licinius and Maximinus. The battle location was on the "Campus Serenus" at Tzirallum, identified as the modern-day town of Çorlu, in Tekirdağ Province, in the Turkish region of Eastern Thrace. Sources put the battle between 18 and 36 Roman miles from Heraclea Perinthus, the modern-day town of Marmara Ereğlisi.

zh.s: 齐拉卢姆战役于313年4月30日爆发，是四帝共治时期内战的一部分。罗马皇帝李锡尼和马克西米努斯的军队在此交战。战场位于齐拉卢姆的“塞雷努斯平原”，即今土耳其东色雷斯泰基尔达省的乔尔卢镇。据史料记载，战场距赫拉克利亚·佩林图斯（今马尔马拉埃雷利西）18至36罗马里。

en.t: Spain gives Christopher Columbus his commission of exploration. He is named admiral of the ocean sea, viceroy and governor of any territory he discovers
en.s: Christopher Columbus (; between 25 August and 31 October 1451 – 20 May 1506) was an Italian explorer and navigator from the Republic of Genoa who completed four Spanish transatlantic voyages in the name of the Catholic Monarchs, opening the way for the widespread European exploration and colonization of the Americas. His expeditions were the first known European contact with the Caribbean and Central and South America.

zh.t: 西班牙授予克里斯托弗·哥伦布探索任务，任命他为大洋海军上将、副王和所发现领土的总督
zh.s: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布（1451年8月25日至10月31日之间出生，1506年5月20日去世）是来自热那亚共和国的意大利探险家和航海家。他代表西班牙天主教君主进行了四次跨大西洋航行，为欧洲人大规模探索和殖民美洲开辟了道路。他的航行是已知欧洲人首次抵达加勒比地区以及中美洲和南美洲。

en.s: The skirmish known as Cleanse the Causeway, or Clear the Causeway, took place in the High Street of Edinburgh, Scotland, on 30 April 1520, between rival noblemen James Hamilton, 1st Earl of Arran, chief of Clan Hamilton, and Archibald Douglas, 6th Earl of Angus, chief of Clan Douglas.

zh.s: 清除堤道之战又称清理堤道之战，于1520年4月30日在苏格兰爱丁堡高街发生。交战双方是彼此敌对的贵族詹姆斯·汉密尔顿（阿伦伯爵一世、汉密尔顿氏族首领）和阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯（安格斯伯爵六世、道格拉斯氏族首领）。

en.s: The Battle of the Sesia or Battle of the Sesia River, took place near the Sesia River (Latin: Sesites or Sessite), situated in north-western Italy, Lombardy, on 30 April 1524, where the Imperial–Spanish forces commanded by Don Carlos de Lannoy, inflicted a decisive defeat to the French forces under the Admiral Guillaume Gouffier, Lord of Bonnivet and Francis de Bourbon, Comte de St.

zh.s: 塞西亚战役，又称塞西亚河战役，于1524年4月30日在意大利西北部伦巴第的塞西亚河附近爆发。唐·卡洛斯·德·拉努瓦指挥的帝国—西班牙联军在此击败了由海军上将纪尧姆·古菲耶、博尼维埃领主，以及圣波朗伯爵弗朗索瓦·德·波旁率领的法军。

en.s: The Battle of Mataquito was fought in the Arauco War on April 30, 1557, between the forces of the Spanish governor, Francisco de Villagra, and Mapuche headed by their toqui Lautaro. It was a surprise attack, carried out at dawn, on Lautaro's fortified camp between a wooded mountain and the shore of the Mataquito River.

zh.s: 马塔基托战役于1557年4月30日爆发，是阿劳科战争的一部分。交战双方是西班牙总督弗朗西斯科·德·比利亚格拉率领的西班牙军队，以及马普切族首领劳塔罗率领的马普切人。马普切军在黎明时分突袭了劳塔罗设在马塔基托河岸、位于林木繁茂山地之间的防御营地。

en.s: The siege of 's-Hertogenbosch also known as the siege of Bois-Le-Duc was an action in 1629, during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War in which a Dutch army captured the city of 's-Hertogenbosch. The city had been loyal to the King of Spain since 1579 and was part of the Spanish Netherlands.

zh.s: 斯海尔托亨博斯围城战又称博斯勒迪克围城战，是1629年八十年战争和英西战争期间的一次军事行动。荷兰军队攻占了斯海尔托亨博斯城。该城自1579年以来一直效忠西班牙国王，属于西属尼德兰。

en.s: The siege of Schenkenschans (30 July 1635 – 30 April 1636) was a major siege of the Eighty Years' War. In a successful campaign the Army of Flanders, commanded by Spanish general Cardinal-Infante Ferdinand of Austria, captured Schenkenschans along with a number of important towns, reversing recent Dutch gains and opening the Dutch Republic to a possible invasion.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 申肯尚斯围城战于1635年7月30日至1636年4月30日进行，是八十年战争中的一场重要围城战。奥地利的费迪南德亲王指挥的西班牙佛兰德斯军在一次成功的战役中攻占申肯尚斯及多个重要城镇，扭转荷兰近期战果，并为入侵荷兰共和国打开通道。

en.s: The battle of Fehmarn (Swedish: Sjöslaget vid Femern; Danish: Slaget ved Rødsand; Dutch: Zeeslag bij Fehmarn), also known as the battle of Rödsund, occurred on 30 April 1659 during the Dano-Swedish War of 1658–1660. It was fought in the Fehmarn Belt between a Swedish fleet under Klas Hansson Bjelkenstjerna and a Dano-Dutch fleet under Jacob van Wassenaer Obdam. The battle ended inconclusively.

zh.s: 费马恩海战（瑞典语：Sjöslaget vid Femern；丹麦语：Slaget ved Rødsand；荷兰语：Zeeslag bij Fehmarn）又称罗兹松海战，于1659年4月30日爆发，是1658至1660年丹麦—瑞典战争的一部分。克拉斯·汉松·比耶肯谢纳率领的瑞典舰队与雅各布·范·瓦瑟纳尔·奥布丹率领的丹麦—荷兰舰队在费马恩海峡交战。战斗没有分出胜负。

en.s: The battle of Billot tower took place in 1703, during the war of the Camisards, when Huguenot rebels led by Jean Cavalier were ambushed in Bagard by Royalist troops.

en.s: The Battle of Kletsk took place on 30 April 1706 (Gregorian calendar), in- and outside the city of Kletsk, Belarus during Charles XII's Polish campaign of 1701–1706, in the Great Northern War. The Swedish forces were led by Carl Gustaf Creutz who defeated a bigger Russian–Cossack force under the command of Semjon Nepljujev and Danylo Apostol.

zh.s: 克列茨克战役于1706年4月30日（格里历）在白俄罗斯克列茨克城内外爆发，是大北方战争期间查理十二世1701至1706年波兰战役的一部分。卡尔·古斯塔夫·克罗伊茨率领的瑞典军队击败了由谢苗·涅普卢耶夫和达尼洛·阿波斯托尔指挥、人数更多的俄罗斯—哥萨克联军。

en.s: The first inauguration of George Washington as the first president of the United States was held on Thursday, April 30, 1789, on the balcony of Federal Hall in New York City. The inauguration was held nearly two months after the beginning of the first four-year term of George Washington as president. Chancellor of New York Robert Livingston administered the presidential oath of office.

zh.s: 1789年4月30日星期四，美国首任总统乔治·华盛顿在纽约市联邦厅阳台举行就职仪式。距离他四年总统任期开始已近两个月。纽约州大法官罗伯特·利文斯顿主持总统宣誓。

en.s: George Washington (February 22, 1732 [O.S. February 11, 1731] – December 14, 1799) was a Founding Father and the first president of the United States, serving from 1789 to 1797. As commander of the Continental Army, Washington led Patriot forces to victory in the American Revolutionary War against the British Empire. He is commonly known as the Father of His Country for his role in bringing about American independence.

zh.t: 乔治·华盛顿就任美国总统
zh.s: 乔治·华盛顿（1732年2月22日〔旧历1731年2月11日〕—1799年12月14日）是美国开国元勋，也是美国首任总统，任期为1789年至1797年。作为大陆军总司令，他率领爱国者军队在美国独立战争中击败大英帝国。由于他在实现美国独立过程中发挥的作用，人们通常称他为“国父”。

en.s: The Battle of Quiévrain was a pair of skirmishes between the Habsburg monarchy and the Kingdom of France in late April 1792 during the War of the First Coalition. On 28 April, there was a minor skirmish at Quiévrain, just across the Franco-Belgian border, resulting in a victory for the French army under the command of general Armand-Louis de Gontaut Biron.

zh.s: 基耶夫兰战役是哈布斯堡君主国与法兰西王国在1792年4月下旬发生的两次小规模交战，属于第一次反法同盟战争。4月28日，法比边境另一侧的基耶夫兰发生一场小规模冲突，由阿尔芒-路易·德·贡托-比龙将军指挥的法军获胜。

en.s: The siege of Landrecies (17–30 April 1794) was a military operation during the Spring 1794 campaign in the Low Countries theatre of the War of the First Coalition. It was conducted by the veldleger (mobile army) of the Dutch States Army, commanded by the Hereditary Prince of Orange, assisted by auxiliary forces from the Habsburg Austrian army, against the fortress of Landrecies, garrisoned by troops of the First French Republic under general Henri Victor Roulland.

zh.s: 兰德勒西围城战于1794年4月17日至30日进行，是第一次反法同盟战争低地国家战区1794年春季战役的一次军事行动。荷兰共和国机动军在奥兰治世袭亲王指挥下，并得到哈布斯堡奥地利军辅助部队支援，围攻由法兰西第一共和国亨利·维克托·鲁朗将军部队驻守的兰德勒西要塞。

en.s: In the Battle of Caldiero or Battle of Soave or Battle of Castelcerino from 27 to 30 April 1809, an Austrian army led by Archduke John of Austria defended against a Franco-Italian army headed by Eugène de Beauharnais, the Viceroy of the Kingdom of Italy. The outnumbered Austrians successfully fended off the attacks of their enemies in actions at San Bonifacio, Soave, and Castelcerino before retreating to the east.

zh.s: 卡尔迪耶罗战役又称索阿韦战役或卡斯泰尔切里诺战役，于1809年4月27日至30日进行。约翰大公率奥地利军队，抵御意大利王国副王欧仁·德·博阿尔内率领的法意联军。奥军人数处于劣势，但在圣博尼法乔、索阿韦和卡斯泰尔切里诺的战斗中成功挡住敌军攻势，随后向东撤退。

en.s: The Battle of the Cherek River was a significant engagement during the Russo-Circassian War, taking place on April 30, 1810, near the Cherek River in Kabarda and Balkaria, regions in the North Caucasus. The battle pitted Russian imperial forces under General S. A. Bulgakov against a coalition of Kabardian and Balkar fighters resisting Russian encroachment on their lands.

zh.s: 切列克河战役于1810年4月30日在高加索北部卡巴尔达和巴尔卡尔地区的切列克河附近发生，是俄—切尔克斯战争期间的一场重要战斗。谢苗·布尔加科夫将军率领的俄罗斯帝国军队与抵抗俄军侵占领土的卡巴尔达和巴尔卡尔联军交战。

en.s: The Battle of El Veladero was a battle of the War of Mexican Independence that occurred from 1810 through 30 April 1811 at El Veladero, Acapulco de Juárez. The battle was fought between royalist forces, loyal to the Spanish crown, commanded by Juan Antonio Fuentes, and Mexican rebels, commanded by José María Morelos and Rafael Valdovinos, fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire. The rebels won.

zh.s: 埃尔韦拉德罗战役是墨西哥独立战争期间的一场战斗，从1810年持续至1811年4月30日，地点在阿卡普尔科胡亚雷斯的埃尔韦拉德罗。交战双方是效忠西班牙王室的保皇派军队和争取脱离西班牙帝国独立的墨西哥起义军。保皇派由胡安·安东尼奥·富恩特斯指挥，起义军由何塞·玛丽亚·莫雷洛斯和拉斐尔·巴尔多维诺斯指挥。起义军获胜。

en.t: 1816–17 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1816–17 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between April 30, 1816, and August 14, 1817. Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives before the first session of the 15th United States Congress convened on December 1, 1817. The size of the House increased to 184 after Indiana and Mississippi achieved statehood.

zh.s: 1816至1817年美国众议院选举在各州分时举行，时间从1816年4月30日到1817年8月14日不等。各州自行决定众议院选举日期；美国第十五届国会于1817年12月1日召开第一次会议。印第安纳州和密西西比州加入联邦后，众议院席位增至184席。

en.s: The Battle of Jamrud was fought between the Emirate of Afghanistan and the Sikh Empire on 30 April 1837. The Sikhs were building up towards crossing the Khyber pass in order to invade Jalalabad. This led Afghan forces to confront the Sikh forces at Jamrud. The death of Sikh General Hari Singh Nalwa limited the Khyber pass as the western extent of the Sikh Empire. The battle resulted in a victory for the Sikh forces.By the time Sikh reinforcements had arrived,The garrison army was able to hold the Afghans.After the battle, Amir Dost Muhammad took up the title of "Commander of the Faithful."

zh.s: 贾姆鲁德战役于1837年4月30日爆发，交战双方是阿富汗埃米尔国和锡克帝国。锡克军正准备穿越开伯尔山口，进攻贾拉拉巴德，因此阿富汗军队在贾姆鲁德与锡克军交战。锡克将军哈里·辛格·纳尔瓦阵亡，使开伯尔山口成为锡克帝国最西端的边界。战斗以锡克军获胜告终。锡克援军抵达时，驻军已能挡住阿富汗军队。战后，阿米尔·多斯特·穆罕默德采用“信士的统帅”称号。

en.s: The Skirmish of Pastrengo, also known as Battle of Pastrengo or Charge of Pastrengo, was fought between the Piedmontese and Austrian army on 30 April 1848, in the course of the First Italian War of Independence. The engagement is mostly remembered for the cavalry charge of the Carabinieri, depicted in numerous Italian artworks.

zh.t: 帕斯特伦戈小规模战斗（1848年）
zh.s: 帕斯特伦戈小规模战斗又称帕斯特伦戈战役或帕斯特伦戈冲锋，于1848年4月30日爆发，交战双方是皮埃蒙特军队和奥地利军队，是第一次意大利独立战争的一部分。此战最为人熟知的是卡宾枪骑兵的冲锋，许多意大利艺术作品都描绘了这一场面。

en.t: Charles Dickens publishes the first edition of his literary magazine, All the Year Round, containing the first installment of his best-selling classic, A Tale of Two Cities
en.s: Charles John Huffam Dickens ( ; 7 February 1812 – 9 June 1870) was an English writer and journalist. He created some of literature's best-known fictional characters, and is regarded by many as the greatest novelist of the Victorian era. His works enjoyed unprecedented popularity during his lifetime and, by the 20th century, critics and scholars had recognised him as a literary genius.

zh.t: 查尔斯·狄更斯创办文学杂志《全年》，首期刊载其畅销经典《双城记》的第一部分
zh.s: 查尔斯·约翰·赫芬·狄更斯（1812年2月7日—1870年6月9日）是英国作家和记者。他创造了文学史上许多最著名的虚构人物；许多人认为他是维多利亚时代最伟大的小说家。他的作品在生前空前畅销，到20世纪，评论家和学者已公认他是一位文学天才。

en.s: The Battle of Camarón (French: Bataille de Camerone) which occurred over ten hours on 30 April 1863 between the French Foreign Legion and the Mexican army, is regarded as a defining moment in the Foreign Legion's history. A small infantry patrol, led by Captain Jean Danjou and Lieutenants Clément Maudet and Jean Vilain, numbering just 65 men was attacked and besieged by a force that may have eventually reached 3,000 Mexican infantry and cavalry, and was forced to make a defensive stand at the nearby Hacienda Camarón, in Camarón de Tejeda, Veracruz, Mexico.

zh.s: 卡梅龙战役（法语：Bataille de Camerone）于1863年4月30日爆发，法国外国军团与墨西哥军队激战十多个小时，被视为外国军团历史上的关键事件。一支由让·当茹上尉和克莱芒·莫代、让·维兰两名中尉率领的步兵巡逻队只有65人，在墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯州特赫达卡梅龙镇附近的卡梅龙庄园遭到袭击和围困。墨西哥骑兵和步兵人数可能多达3000人，法军小队被迫坚守阵地。

en.s: The Battle of Day's Gap, fought on April 30, 1863, was the first in a series of American Civil War skirmishes in Cullman County, Alabama, that lasted until May 2, known as Streight's Raid. Commanding the Union forces was Col. Abel Streight; Brig. Gen. Nathan Bedford Forrest led the Confederate forces.

zh.s: 戴斯峡谷战役于1863年4月30日发生，是美国内战期间一系列小规模战斗的首场战斗。这些战斗在阿拉巴马州卡尔曼县持续到5月2日，统称斯特雷特突袭。联邦军由阿贝尔·斯特雷特上校指挥，邦联军由内森·贝德福德·福雷斯特准将率领。

en.s: The Battle of Jenkins' Ferry (April 30, 1864) was fought in present-day Grant County, Arkansas, during the American Civil War. It was the climactic battle of the Camden Expedition, part of the Red River Campaign. As a result of the battle, United States forces were able to complete a successful retreat from a precarious position at Camden to their defenses at Little Rock.

zh.s: 詹金斯渡口战役于1864年4月30日在美国内战期间爆发，地点在今阿肯色州格兰特县境内。这是卡姆登远征的决战，属于红河战役的一部分。战斗使联邦军成功从卡姆登的危险处境撤退，返回小石城防线。

en.t: American Civil War: Confederate forces led by General E. Kirby Smith attack federal troops retreating across the Saline at Jenkins' Ferry, Arkansas
en.s: The American Civil War (April 12, 1861 – May 26, 1865; also known by other names) was a civil war in the United States between the Union ("the North") and the Confederacy ("the South"), which was formed in 1861 by Southern states that had seceded from the Union to preserve slavery in the United States.

zh.t: 美国内战：E·柯比·史密斯将军率领邦联军，在阿肯色州詹金斯渡口袭击正渡过萨林河撤退的联邦军
zh.s: 美国内战（1861年4月12日—1865年5月26日，又有其他称呼）是美国联邦（“北方”）与邦联（“南方”）之间的内战。邦联于1861年由脱离联邦的南方各州组建，目的是维护美国的奴隶制。

en.s: The Camp Grant massacre, on April 30, 1871, was an attack on Pinal and Aravaipa Apaches who surrendered to the United States Army at Camp Grant, Arizona, along the San Pedro River. The massacre led to a series of battles and campaigns fought between the Americans, the Apache, and their Yavapai allies, which continued into 1875, the most notable being General George Crook's Tonto Basin Campaign of 1872 and 1873.

zh.s: 格兰特营大屠杀发生于1871年4月30日。美国军队袭击了在亚利桑那州圣佩德罗河畔格兰特营向其投降的皮纳尔和阿拉瓦伊帕阿帕奇人。大屠杀引发了一系列美国人与阿帕奇人及其雅瓦派盟友之间的战斗和军事行动，一直持续到1875年，其中最著名的是乔治·克鲁克将军于1872至1873年进行的通托盆地战役。

en.s: The Lushai Rising was the conflict between the British and the Lushai chiefs in 1890-1895, which began following the annexation of the Lushai Hills after the Chin-Lushai Expedition. It concerned the Western chiefs, the Eastern chief and Southern chiefs separately at different intervals. By 1895, the Lushai resistance and rising was considered over.

en.s: The Territory of Hawaii or Hawaii Territory (Hawaiian: Panalāʻau o Hawaiʻi) was an organized incorporated territory of the United States that existed from April 30, 1900, until August 21, 1959, when most of its territory was admitted to the United States as the 50th US state, the State of Hawaii. The Hawaii Admission Act specified that the State of Hawaii would not include Palmyra Island, the Midway Islands, Kingman Reef, Johnston Atoll and Sand Island.
en.n: In early 1900, Congress passed an Act To provide a government for the Territory of Hawaii, which was signed into law by President William McKinley on April 30, 1900.

zh.s: 夏威夷领地是美国的一个有组织、并入联邦的领土，存在于1900年4月30日至1959年8月21日。1959年8月21日，大部分领土加入美国，成为第50个州夏威夷州。《夏威夷州加入联邦法案》规定，巴尔米拉环礁、中途岛、金曼礁、约翰斯顿环礁和沙岛不属于新州。
zh.n: 1900年初，国会通过《夏威夷领地政府法》，威廉·麦金莱总统于1900年4月30日签署该法案。

en.s: The Battles of Vuksan and Matejče were a series of clashes that occurred on 30 April 1905 between Serbian Chetnik forces and the Ottoman army. While moving towards Matejče, Kosta Pećanac's company was ambushed and surrounded an Ottoman army, which was equipped with mountain artillery. The fight lasted until deep into the night, when the Chetniks broke through the encirclement without casualties.

zh.s: 武克桑和马泰切战役是1905年4月30日塞尔维亚切特尼克部队与奥斯曼军队之间的一系列交战。科斯塔·佩恰纳茨率领的部队在前往马泰切途中遭伏击，并被配备山地火炮的奥斯曼军队包围。战斗持续到深夜，切特尼克部队突破包围，未造成人员伤亡。

en.s: The 1912 Tasmanian state election was held on Tuesday, 30 April 1912 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 30 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — six members were elected from each of five electorates. Elliott Lewis was elected as an Anti-Socialist at the 1909 election, and was Premier of Tasmania from 27 October 1909.

en.s: (Main article: Chemical weapons in World War I) The Gas attacks at Wulverghem in the municipality of Heuvelland were two German cloud gas attacks during World War I on British troops near Ypres in the Belgian province of West Flanders. The first gas discharge took place on 30 April 1916 and was followed by another attack on 17 June. The gas attacks at Wulverghem were part of the sporadic fighting, which took place between battles in the Ypres Salient on the Western Front. The British Second Army held the ground from Messines Ridge north to Steenstraat.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，德国军队在比利时西佛兰德省于弗尔兰德市镇的乌尔弗赫姆附近，对英军发动了两次毒气袭击。第一次释放毒气发生于1916年4月30日，第二次袭击则在6月17日。袭击是西线伊普尔突出部战役间歇期零星战斗的一部分。英国第二集团军控制着从梅森岭向北至斯廷斯特拉特一带的阵地。

That day, farmers and landowners loyal to the Ukrainian lieutenant general Pavlo Skoropadskyi, with the support of the German Empire, launched a coup d'état against the government of the Ukrainian People's Republic, removing the Central Rada and installing Skoropadskyi as hetman.

en.t: The Federal Industrial Institute for Women opens in Alderson, West Virginia, as the first women's federal prison in the United States
en.s: The Federal Prison Camp, Alderson (FPC Alderson) is a minimum-security United States federal prison for female inmates in West Virginia. It is operated by the Federal Bureau of Prisons, a division of the United States Department of Justice. FPC Alderson is in two West Virginia counties, near the town of Alderson. A portion of the prison is in unincorporated Monroe County, while the other portion of the prison, including the dormitories, is in unincorporated Summers County.

en.s: The Escobar Rebellion was a conflict in northern Mexico in 1929 during the Maximato, between the government forces of President Emilio Portes Gil and rebel forces under the command of General José Gonzalo Escobar. After some initial success in taking over several key cities in the northern half of the country, the Escobar rebels were decisively defeated in a major battle at Jiménez, Chihuahua, and were eventually swept aside by the advancing government forces under the command of General Calles.

en.s: The issue concerning women's suffrage in the Philippines was settled in a special plebiscite held on April 30, 1937. Ninety percent of voters were in favor of the measure. In compliance with the 1935 Constitution, the National Assembly passed a law which extended the right of suffrage to women, a right which still remains. As mandated by Commonwealth Act No. 34, women who meets the same qualification for men voted in the plebiscite. 86 percent of those who registered for the plebiscite made a vote. Those who registered comprises 29 percent of women voters eligible for the plebiscite.

zh.s: 菲律宾妇女选举权问题通过1937年4月30日举行的特别公投得到解决。90%的选民支持该措施。根据1935年宪法，国民议会通过法律赋予妇女选举权，该权利至今仍然有效。《联邦法》第34号规定，符合与男性相同资格条件的妇女可以参加公投。登记参加公投的女性中，86%投了票；登记女性占符合公投资格女性的29%。

en.s: General elections were held in Japan on 30 April 1937 to elect the 466 members of the House of Representatives, after the dissolution of Parliament on 31 March. Rikken Minseitō emerged as the largest party in Parliament, with 179 of the 466 seats. The election was a major success for Shakai Taishūtō, which became the third-largest party in the Diet, the first socialist party to do so in Japanese history.

en.s: The 21st General Election of Japan of the House of Representatives took place in Japan on April 30, 1942. It was the only election in Japan during the Pacific theater of World War II. At this time, the lower house no longer had any significant executive and legislative power, and power had increasingly gone to the military since the "Manchurian Incident", the invasion of Manchuria by the Imperial Army without regard to the (then still civilian) cabinet in 1931. Since 1932 when Admiral Viscount Saitō Makoto was appointed prime minister with the first so-called "national unity cabinet", few members of the political parties in the House of Representatives had any significant role in government.

zh.s: 1942年4月30日，日本举行第二十一届众议院大选。这是太平洋战争期间日本唯一一次选举。当时，下议院已不再拥有显著的行政和立法权力；自1931年日本帝国陆军不顾当时仍由文官组成的内阁而入侵满洲、引发“满洲事变”以来，军方权力不断扩大。1932年海军大将斋藤实出任首相、组建首个所谓“举国一致内阁”后，众议院里的政党成员很少能在政府事务中发挥重要作用。

en.s: Raising a Flag over the Reichstag (Russian: Знамя Победы над Рейхстагом, romanized: Znamya Pobedy nad Reykhstagom) is a World War II photograph that symbolizes the Soviet Union's victory over Nazi Germany during the Battle in Berlin. en.s: The Organization of American States (OAS or OEA; Spanish: Organización de los Estados Americanos; Portuguese: Organização dos Estados Americanos; French: Organisation des États américains) is an international organization founded on 30 April 1948 to promote cooperation among its member states within the Americas. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., United States, the OAS is a voluntary "multilateral regional body focused on human rights, electoral oversight, social and economic development, and security in the Western Hemisphere", according to the Council on Foreign Relations.

zh.s: 美洲国家组织（OAS或OEA；西班牙语：Organización de los Estados Americanos；葡萄牙语：Organização dos Estados Americanos；法语：Organisation des États américains）是一个国际组织，成立于1948年4月30日，旨在促进美洲成员国之间的合作。总部位于美国华盛顿特区。根据外交关系委员会的说法，这是一个自愿组成的“多边区域组织，关注西半球的人权、选举监督、社会和经济发展及安全”。

en.s: The Supplementary Convention on the Abolition of Slavery, the full title of which is the Supplementary Convention on the Abolition of Slavery, the Slave Trade, and Institutions and Practices Similar to Slavery, is a 1956 United Nations treaty which builds upon the 1926 Slavery Convention, which is still operative and which proposed to secure the abolition of slavery and of the slave trade, and the Forced Labour Convention of 1930, which banned forced or compulsory labour, by banning debt bondage, serfdom, child marriage, servile marriage, and child servitude.

en.t: Democratic Republic of the Congo general election, 1965
en.s: General elections were held in the Democratic Republic of the Congo between 18 March and 30 April 1965, following the promulgation of a new constitution approved by a referendum the previous year. 223 political parties contested the election for 167 seats in the Chamber of Deputies. The elections were won by parties allied with the Congolese National Convention, led by former secessionist leader Moise Tshombe, which won a total of 80 seats. Following the elections, the results were disputed by several parties. The Léopoldville Court of Appeal accepted six of them, and re-runs were required in Kivu Central, Goma-Rutshuru, Cuvette Centrale, Fizi, Kwilu and Maniema, which were held between 8 and 22 August 1965.

en.s: The 1999 London nail bombings were a series of bomb explosions in London, England. Over three successive weekends between 17 and 30 April 1999, homemade nail bombs were detonated in Brixton in south London; at Brick Lane, Spitalfields, in the East End; and at the Admiral Duncan pub in Soho in the West End. Each bomb contained up to 1,500 100-millimetre (3.9 in) nails in duffel bags that were left in public spaces.

en.s: The Sikkim Legislative Assembly election of 2009 took place in April 2009, concurrently with the Indian general election, 2009. Incumbent Chief Minister Pawan Kumar Chamling's Government returned for an unprecedented fourth consecutive term having won previous elections in 1994, 1999 and 2004.

en.s: On 30 April 2014, a knife attack and bombing occurred in the Chinese city of Ürümqi, Xinjiang. The incident, a terrorist attack, left three people dead and seventy-nine others injured. en.s: The 2017 KNVB Cup final was a football match between Vitesse and AZ on 30 April 2017 at De Kuip, Rotterdam. It was the final match of the 2016–17 KNVB Cup competition and the 99th Dutch Cup Final. Vitesse beat AZ 2–0 to secure their first KNVB Cup trophy and win even their first silverware in their 125-year history.

zh.s: 2017年荷兰杯决赛于2017年4月30日在鹿特丹德奎普球场举行，由维特斯对阵阿尔克马尔。这是2016至2017赛季荷兰杯的决赛，也是荷兰杯历史上的第99场决赛。维特斯以2比0获胜，首次夺得荷兰杯冠军，也是建队125年来首次赢得重要奖杯。

en.s: The 2017 Democratic Party leadership election was an open primary election held on 30 April 2017. The three candidates were Matteo Renzi, former Prime Minister and party secretary until February 2017, Michele Emiliano, President of Apulia, and Andrea Orlando, the Minister of Justice. Renzi was elected by a landslide 70%, and appointed Maurizio Martina as his deputy secretary.

zh.s: 2017年4月30日，意大利民主党举行开放式初选，选举党魁。三名候选人分别是前总理、截至2017年2月仍任党魁的马泰奥·伦齐，普利亚大区主席米凯莱·埃米利亚诺，以及司法部长安德烈亚·奥兰多。伦齐以70%的压倒性得票率当选，并任命毛里齐奥·马尔蒂纳为副党魁。

en.t: United Arab Emirates occupation of Socotra
en.s: On 30 April 2018, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) deployed more than a hundred troops with artillery and armored vehicles to the Yemeni archipelago of Socotra in the Guardafui Channel without prior coordination with the Yemeni government, causing the relations of the two countries to deteriorate. The initial deployment consisted of UAE military aircraft carrying more than fifty UAE soldiers and two armored vehicles, followed by two more aircraft carrying more soldiers, tanks and other armored vehicles.

en.t: The Heisei era ended on 30 April 2019 (Heisei 31), with the abdication of Akihito from the Chrysanthemum Throne
en.s: The Heisei era (平成; Japanese: [heːseː] ) was the period of Japanese history corresponding to the reign of Emperor Akihito from 8 January 1989 until his abdication on 30 April 2019. The Heisei era started on 8 January 1989, the day after the death of the Emperor Hirohito, when his elder son, Akihito, acceded to the throne as the 125th Emperor of Japan.

zh.s: 平成时代（平成；日语：[heːseː]）是日本历史上的一个时期，对应明仁天皇自1989年1月8日至2019年4月30日退位期间的统治。平成时代于1989年1月8日开始，也就是裕仁天皇去世次日，长子明仁继位，成为日本第125代天皇。

en.s: Local elections were held in the Indian state of Telangana on 30 April 2021 for 2 municipal corporations and 5 municipalities, namely Warangal, Khammam, Jadcherla, Achampet, Siddipet, Kothur, and Nakrekal. zh.s: 2021年4月30日，印度特伦甘纳邦举行地方选举，为两家市政公司和五个市镇选举议员，涉及瓦朗加尔、卡姆曼、贾德切尔拉、阿昌佩特、锡迪佩特、科图尔和纳克雷卡尔。贾德切尔拉、科图尔和纳克雷卡尔是新设市镇，首次举行选举。

en.s: The 2023 A-League Women grand final was the 14th A-League Women Grand Final, the championship-deciding match of the Australian A-League Women, and the culmination of the 2022–23 season. The match was played between Western United and Sydney FC on 30 April 2023 at CommBank Stadium in Sydney. The match was Western United's first A-League Women Grand Final in their inaugural season, and the ninth for Sydney FC, as well as six consecutive appearances in the A-League Women Grand Final.

zh.t: 2023年澳大利亚女子A联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2023年澳大利亚女子A联赛总决赛是该项赛事第14场总决赛，决出2022至2023赛季冠军。西部联队于2023年4月30日在悉尼的CommBank体育场对阵悉尼FC。这是西部联队在首个赛季首次进入总决赛，也是悉尼FC第九次闯入总决赛，并连续第六年参赛。

en.s: General elections were held in Paraguay on 30 April 2023 to elect the president, vice president, National Congress, and departmental governors. The incumbent president Mario Abdo Benítez and vice president Hugo Velázquez Moreno, both of the Colorado Party, were ineligible for re-election. The Colorado candidate, former Finance Minister Santiago Peña, defeated both PLRA president Efraín Alegre from the Concertación alliance and former senator Paraguayo Cubas from the populist National Crusade Party.

zh.s: 巴拉圭于2023年4月30日举行大选，选举总统、副总统、国会及各省省长。时任总统马里奥·阿布多·贝尼特斯和副总统乌戈·贝拉斯克斯·莫雷诺均因任期限制无法竞选连任。红党候选人、前财政部长圣地亚哥·培尼亚击败了自由激进党主席、联盟候选人埃夫拉因·阿莱格雷，以及民粹主义民族十字军党前参议员巴拉圭·库巴斯。

en.t: 2024 New York's 26th congressional district special election
en.s: The 2024 New York's 26th congressional district special election was held on April 30, 2024, to fill the vacant seat in New York's 26th congressional district. The seat became vacant after Democratic incumbent Brian Higgins resigned on February 2, 2024, to become president of Shea's Performing Arts Center. The early voting period ran from April 20 to April 28, 2024.

zh.s: 纽约州第26国会选区于2024年4月30日举行特别选举，填补空缺席位。原民主党议员布赖恩·希金斯于2024年2月2日辞职，出任Shea表演艺术中心主席，导致席位空缺。提前投票于2024年4月20日至28日举行。
